intent: Which Context may call which is a domain decision, so it lives in the reviewed Registry and is read from there, not mirrored in a document.
actor: A developer opening a new cross-context call
observable_outcome: The machine check that enforces the boundary reads the reviewed dependency policies; opening a new call requires a signed Change Package, and nothing else grants it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Registry holds one reviewed dependency policy for each collaboration the retired whitelist permitted, and none that it did not.
A dependency policy whose from or to is not a Context in the Registry is refused.
The permission every Context has on identity is recorded as one policy per Context, so no collaboration is granted by a blank left-hand side.
